Watch: Keep a close eye on your leveraged positions (SOXL, SPAL) and consider adjusting their stops or trimming. The broader market sentiment is mixed, so caution is key.

Bottom line: Manage your existing risk, especially in leveraged positions, before considering new opportunities.
plays: SOXL: Review your stop. At -45.03% and leveraged, this position needs immediate attention to prevent further amplified losses.
SPAL: Address the -47.87% loss. As a new, leveraged position, consider trimming or setting a realistic stop below current price to limit downside.
